title: Generative fill: redraw a selection of a canvas
description: A canvas action: select an area of a canvas in the Canvas view, say what should be there, and the area is redrawn at the model's full detail (FLUX.2 Klein 4B, 4 steps) and added as a new layer with a soft-edged mask, to keep, hide or delete. The Canvas view's task bar lists it; open it here to edit the workflow.
